brief.prompt: Seed pitch for Potluck, an app that lets neighbours share home-cooked meals at cost.

outline.governing_thought: Potluck turns the meals neighbours already cook into a trusted, at-cost local network, and $2.5M seed funds proving it works city by city.
key_points: Home cooks make more food than they eat
Neighbours want real meals without cost or hassle
Potluck matches them at cost with built-in trust
Neighbourhood density drives retention and growth
Seed funds launch cities and prove repeatable playbook
